title: Reranking didn't improve results — 7 reasons why | reranker.uk
description: Added a reranker and saw no improvement? The usual causes are retrieval recall, too small a candidate pool, silent truncation at the model's token limit, oversized chunks, language mismatch, and misreading uncalibrated scores. A diagnostic walkthrough with a checklist.
og_title: Your reranker didn't improve results. Here's why
og_description: Seven reasons reranking shows no lift — and how to tell which one you have.
